run_sft_training: run supervised fine-tuning training for a causal language model using SFTTrainer with a config dict or LLMTrainingParams
configure_peft_lora: configure LoRA parameters including rank, alpha, dropout, and target modules for PEFT fine-tuning
process_training_data: process input training and validation data with chat template tokenization using the utils module
setup_sft_config: set up SFTConfig training arguments including logging steps, block size, and data packing
create_sft_trainer: create an SFTTrainer instance with model, datasets, callbacks, and optional PEFT configuration
